freeze_stage: After field/type schema inspection only, before score or response-value analysis.

primary.row_unit: One terminal real round per (topology,question_index) per source file, selecting maximum round among padded=false rows. No included-flag or correctness filtering. Retain original group appearance order. Fail on duplicate rounds, changing gold or missing real group.
primary.reference_policy: exclude invalid reference as original One-Eval default; report counts explicitly
primary.comparability: Check exact group key and gold alignment across all seven systems; do not silently intersect cohorts.

secondary.row_unit: Every agent_final_answers entry in the selected terminal real rounds, including malicious agents, ordered by source group then agent index; descriptive stress replay, no independent-trial claim.

analysis.exact_reducer_replay: Derive chunk counts/correct values from canonical per-row details. Verify all reported score formulas against actual unmodified run_bench calls in source order, every metric name and worker count. Verify permutations by actual unmodified calls for seeds 0 and 9 at workers 2 and 8. Other permutation scores use exact reducer replay with this distinction recorded.
analysis.pairs: All 21 pairs per dataset. Reversal requires nonzero signs of opposite sign; ties reported separately. No pooled winner comparison across unrelated datasets.
analysis.impact: Absolute score change in percentage points, strict order reversals, top-set changes, metadata loss, order sensitivity.
analysis.statistics: Descriptive finite-corpus result. No p-value or independence claim: topologies share questions; models reuse the same source corpus.

scope: Retrospective controlled replay of real GAMMAF outputs in One-Eval supported configurations. Does not establish these reports were originally evaluated with One-Eval or how often affected configurations occur naturally.
